item: Rows 374 and 375 (Audit 17 QUAL-1, PERF-4, SEC-2): ruff ratchet to the measured 390, the omni docstring's stale 2x FTS claim, sysctl by full path
summary: QUAL-1: scripts/ruff_ratchet.py measured 390 advisory findings with ruff 0.17.4 on main 3ef066014 against a ceiling of 411, so ci.yml now runs --max 390 (the audit's 432/389 were already stale). PERF-4: the omni route's docstring said it runs 2x full FTS search_ids per keystroke, but the code runs ONE shared _fts_hits for the articles and wiki groups; the audit was misled by the comment, so only the docstring changes. SEC-2: the diagnostics bundle's macOS CPU line ran a bare sysctl, which PATH could answer from a directory ahead of /usr/sbin; it now runs /usr/sbin/sysctl, pinned by a test that fakes darwin and captures the argv (fails on the old code).
